_status: UNSIGNED PROPOSAL. Not part of proofline.json until the owner merges these tasks into the contract and re-signs it on his own machine. tools/vv.py does not read this file.
_why: Integrations bring other ecosystems into the one suite. Each is a thin entry point with the same check IDs, report and corpus, so every criterion below tests that funnel, not only the code.

tasks.title: One report, test-framework entry points and opt-in corpus sharing

criteria.statement: The Node P1-P5 port agrees with the Python CLI on every fixture answer (pass/fail per check ID)

verifier.cmd: cd ts && npx tsc -p . && node --test dist/test/resource.test.js

criteria.statement: runConformance and the matchers pass stock @x402/hono and @x402/express on Solana devnet and Base Sepolia, catch a server that serves on any /settle answer, and every failure message links to its fix, the corpus and the share form

verifier.cmd: cd ts && npx tsc -p . && node --test dist/test/testing.test.js && npx vitest run --config vitest.config.mjs

criteria.statement: An anonymised case contains no URL, host, IP, address or transaction data, and nothing is sent without the user opening the link
Every report carries schema x402-conformance.report/1 and a via from the fixed list; the User-Agent names via and nothing else

tasks.title: MCP server and agent-framework tools (Vercel AI SDK, LangChain)

criteria.statement: The MCP server lists seven tools over real stdio; the demo passes on the reference demo server and catches serve_on_any_settle; every result names via=mcp and links to the fix, the corpus and the share form

verifier.cmd: cd ts && npm run build && cd mcp && npm test

criteria.statement: The probe tool refuses any non-loopback URL, and the AI SDK and LangChain adapters expose only the four read-only tools
MCP registry metadata (server.json name, package and version) matches package.json mcpName and the README mcp-name marker

tasks.title: Python entry-point tag and corpus case, Docker image and GitLab CI template

criteria.statement: Python and TypeScript derive the identical anonymised case from the shared fixture

The image builds, carries the MCP registry name, answers MCP initialize on stdio with no arguments, and its ci command passes the reference server and fails a faulty one with an anonymised case under X402_SHARE
The GitLab template runs exactly x402-conformance ci with X402CONF_VIA=gitlab
